text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I run into a very tired-looking Vodka in the academy hallway…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ughhh… My body just feels so heavy lately…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I dunno why. I'm not staying up late, and I'm eating properly…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No, I gotta snap out of it! If I stand around worryin' all day, it's gonna make me look lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I've gotta cool my head for starters. Maybe I'll go splash some water on my face…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …She seems to be quite tired. We might want to reconsider how many races we're tackling.
